evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 3.3 ppm at growth onset, consistent with the low post-purge baseline.
Oxygen increased to 17.1 ppm during growth, following consecutive increases.
Oxygen reached 33.2 ppm after a sustained rise through 22.2 and 26.2 ppm; this indicates loss of the established low-oxygen condition.
Temperature 750.5 °C at a 750 °C setpoint, heater power 45.4%, argon 99.2 sccm at a 100 sccm setpoint, and pressure 760.1 Torr show no corresponding temperature, flow, or pressure deviation.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and leak/inlet-gas checks are needed to distinguish air ingress (including a seal leak), gas contamination, outgassing, and oxygen-sensor error; sample characterization is not yet available.
